name: smogguard-ai
description: SmogGuard AI — Urban Air Quality & Winter Smog Assistant

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(h => h.createServer((req,res) => { const fs = await import('fs'); const p = req.url === '/' ? '/index.html' : req.url; const ext = p.split('.').pop(); const m = {html:'text/html',css:'text/css',js:'application/javascript',json:'application/json'}; try { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': m[ext]||'text/plain'}); res.end(fs.readFileSync('.' + p)); } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Serving on http://localhost:3000')))"

author: Vishwajeet Kumar
